name: Wirken: per-agent model-time budget exceeded
message:
A Wirken agent reached its per-agent model-time ceiling for the current budget window: the wall-clock seconds its model calls took, as the gateway measured them.

Detection: budget_exceeded (10), model-time ceiling
Severity baseline: medium

`@wirken.event.action` is `blocked` (the LLM call was refused, an enforced stop) or `alerted` (the ceiling was crossed and the call proceeded). Pivot on @wirken.event.agent_id, @wirken.event.window, @wirken.event.model_time.window_model_seconds, @wirken.event.model_time.ceiling_model_seconds.

On this row `@wirken.event.window_spend_usd_micros` and `@wirken.event.ceiling_usd_micros` hold the window's USD spend and the USD ceiling beside it, 0 where the budget sets none. They are not the breach.

Emitted by the wirken runtime's pre-call budget gate. Requires the `model_time` field on budget_exceeded (Wirken main after 3.3.1) and the default budget_exceeded forwarding.

@security-team
